description: Audits an ERC-20 token for honeypots, hidden mints, blacklists, abusive taxes, paused swaps, and stealth proxies using deployed tokenAddress (live 5-EVM RPC bytecode scan), pre-deploy Solidity code, or both (omitting both returns -32602). Read-only across chainId (default 8453 Base; tokenName labels the output), returning verdict, canSell, rugProbabilityScore (0-100), and PROCEED/CAUTION/ABORT. Set tier to FULL ($0.12 USDC, default) for evidence and sellSimulation, or ESSENTIAL ($0.04 USDC) for verdict scalars only; unpaid calls return isError: true (0.15% SLA or 5%-10% Safe-Harbor split applies to live-TVL rescue fixes). Use before swapping tokens; use ingravity_auditSolidityContract for general Solidity source.

chainId.description: EVM Chain ID for RPC lookup when tokenAddress is supplied (8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 10 Optimism, 137 Polygon, 1 Ethereum; unknown falls back to 8453).

code.description: Optional Solidity (.sol) source code for pre-deployment 14-rule rugpull AST scan or hybrid source + bytecode analysis.

tier.description: Billing & output depth: FULL ($0.12 USDC) returns sellSimulation, liveOnChainForensics, risk pillars, and forensicEvidence; ESSENTIAL ($0.04 USDC) returns verdict, canSell, score, and action scalars only.

tokenAddress.description: Deployed 42-char EVM ERC-20 contract address (0x...) inspected via live RPC bytecode & proxy slots (no Solidity source required). Provide tokenAddress, code, or both.

tokenName.description: Optional token ticker or label echoed in the report.

name: ingravity_scanTokenRugpullAndHoneypot

canSell.description: True when no transfer locks, honeypot hooks, or blocking traps were detected.

forensicEvidence.description: Matched AST and bytecode rules with snippets (FULL tier only).

inspectionMode.description: Whether inspection used live RPC bytecode, static Solidity AST, or hybrid.

isHoneypotLikely.description: True if explicit sell-blocking or honeypot trap signatures matched.

liveOnChainForensics.description: Live RPC bytecode size, proxy implementation, owner status, and pause state (FULL tier only).

pillars.description: Boolean breakdown across 6 rugpull pillars (FULL tier only).

rugProbabilityScore.description: Weighted rugpull risk score from 0 to 100.

sellSimulation.description: Simulated sellability and liquidity-lock indicators (FULL tier only).

settled.description: Whether x402 USDC payment settled cleanly.

tokenAddress.description: Inspected token address (null when scanning pre-deploy code only).

title: ERC-20 Token Honeypot & Rugpull Safety Scanner
